theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  have h_eval_qMap (k : Fin 2) :=
    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
      _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩).symm
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap, Subtype.eq_iff] at h_eval_qMap
  trans (evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val * (1 - r_chal) +
    (oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val * r_chal
  · simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp,
      h_eval_qMap, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X]
    simp only [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt, Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul, Submodule.coe_add,
      get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, zero_smul, zero_add]
    ring
  · simp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
        intermediateEvaluationPoly, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_C_mul, Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    ring

theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  dsimp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars]
  intro x
  fun_induction substOld
  any_goals with_reducible exact List.mem_append_left _
  case case7 => exact List.mem_append_right _
  case case5 => assumption
  all_goals simp only [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.mem_append] at *
  all_goals repeat' first | assumption | refine or_or_distrib_right.mpr ∘ Or.imp ?_ ?_

lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let T := (ι (𝓕 := 𝓕)).toLinearMap.comp timeOrderF
  let C := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  let M := LinearMap.mul ℂ 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra
  apply LinearMap.congr_fun₂ (f := (M.comp (LinearMap.mulRight ℂ C)).compr₂ T)
    (g := M.compr₂ ((LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (ι C)).comp T))
  apply LinearMap.ext_basis ofCrAnListFBasis ofCrAnListFBasis
  intro φs' φs
  simp only [LinearMap.compr₂_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.mulRight_apply,
    LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, LinearMap.mul_apply', ofListBasis_eq_ofList,
    AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, T, C, M]
  let S := List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)
  let E := fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ
  let X := ι (ofCrAnListF (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
    S)) *
    ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter E φs'))
  let Y := ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter E φs)) *
    ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)
    S))
  have split (l : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp)
      (hl : ∀ c ∈ l, E c) :
      ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ l ++ φs))) =
      X * ι (ofCrAnListF l) * Y := by
    rw [crAnTimeOrderList, insertionSort_of_eq_list _ _ _ _ _ hl]
    simp only [ofCrAnListF_append, map_mul, X, Y, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  calc
    _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
        (X * ι C * Y) := by
      conv_lhs =>
        rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF]
        simp [mul_sub, sub_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_append]
        rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
      have s1 := split [φ, ψ] (by simp [E, hφψ, hψφ, crAnTimeOrderRel_refl])
      have s2 := split [ψ, φ] (by simp [E, hφψ, hψφ, crAnTimeOrderRel_refl])
      simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append] at s1 s2
      simp only [map_smul]
      rw [← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ, s1, s2]
      simp [C, superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
        ← ofCrAnListF_append, mul_sub, sub_mul]
      rw [smul_sub, smul_comm]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)]
      have hXY := split [] (by simp)
      simp only [List.append_nil, ofCrAnListF_nil, map_one, mul_one] at hXY
      rw [mul_assoc, ← hXY]
      by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) ≠ (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
      · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, smul_zero]
      · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ (not_not.mp hq).symm,
          ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
        simp only [map_smul, mul_smul_comm]

theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  have replace (a b : Fin 9 → ℤ) (i : Fin 9) :
      digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then b j else a j) =
        digits_to_num a + (b i - a i) * 10^i.1 := by
    apply eq_add_of_sub_eq'
    simp only [hdigits_to_num, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← sub_mul,
      ite_sub, sub_self, ite_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  intro d e f h i
  simp only [hrelation, replace] at h
  choose k hk using h.1.2
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := h.2.2 i
  apply (show IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) 10 by norm_num).pow_right (n := i.1) |>.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
  use (∑ j, k j) - digits_to_num d - k i - l
  simp only [mul_sub, Finset.mul_sum, ← hk, ← hl, sub_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [hdigits_to_num]
  ring1
